recommended_actions_freeform_experimenta: It would be prudent to pull the message content into a sandbox environment for deeper inspection—look for obfuscated URLs or attachments that might trigger known malware signatures. Because the evidence count is high yet no direct malicious indicators exist, you might also want to query internal logs for similar outbound patterns from victimcorp.com—if other employees received comparable “booking confirmation” emails, that would strengthen the case for a coordinated phishing attempt.  Finally, consider setting up a temporary quarantine rule for any future mail from grandmerchant‑hotel.com until its legitimacy can be confirmed by the hotel’s IT or through an external verification channel.
